item.title: Mel's Drive-In Diner on Lombard Suffers Major Fire
item.description: A fire broke out in the kitchen of Mel's Drive-In on San Francisco's Lombard Street early Tuesday, causing significant damage to the restaurant.

item.title: C-3PO Himself, Actor Anthony Daniels, Coming to Castro Theatre for May the 4th
item.description: This year’s May the 4th Star Wars celebrations have the droid you’re looking for, as Anthony Daniels, who played C-3PO in eleven different Star Wars movies, comes to the Castro for an ‘Empire Strikes Back’ screening.

item.title: Katie Porter and Eric Swalwell Bow Out of First Gubernatorial Debate In SF
item.description: Seven of the umpteen candidates running for California governor are confirmed to appear at a debate happening this evening in San Francisco's Bayview, and being broadcast live. But two of the more prominent ones will be absent.

item.title: Fire on Pier 28 Causes Temporary Closure of Embarcadero
item.description: A fire broke out in a pier building on Pier 28 Tuesday morning, the second here in just over a year, leading to a subsequent traffic snarl in the area of Embarcadero and Bryant streets.

item.title: Hotels and Airbnbs Are Making Bank by Gouging Super Bowl Visitors This Week
item.description: The inevitable surge pricing is now underway as the Super Bowl tourists come pouring into SF, with some hotels up to nearly $2,500 a night, and some SF Airbnb units costing $2,000 for the weekend stay.

item.title: Offensive Billboards Appear In SF Promoting ICE as 'Defensive Player of the Year'
item.description: Some hastily put together, pro-ICE electronic billboard ads, paid for by a shady outfit with no known donors, have appeared in San Francisco ahead of the Super Bowl, and maybe in other cities as well.

item.title: Epstein Files Reveal Where He Dined With Zuckerberg In Bay Area, and He Was Denied a Table at Flour + Water
item.description: The SF Bay Area has many cameos in the three million pages of new Epstein Files that just dropped, and Mark Zuckerberg has a very uncomfortable mention, while Flour + Water comes out looking good for denying Epstein a table.

item.title: San Ramon Residents Still Bracing for 'Big One' After Day With 75 Earthquakes
item.description: It hasn't been felt very much in San Francisco, but the earthquake swarm that has been rocking San Ramon for the past three months had its most active day on Monday, with a barrage of 75 small and mid-size earthquakes. And residents in the area are pretty on edge.

item.title: Two Teen Suspects Arrested in Friday’s Fatal Shooting of 15-Year-Old Jayda Mabrey
item.description: A 15-year-old and a 16-year-old were arrested Monday over the fatal Friday night Western Addition shooting of 15-year-old Jayda Mabrey, a shooting that also hospitalized two other victims.

item.title: Day Around the Bay: Yes, There Will Be Federal Agents in SF for the Super Bowl
item.description: A PG&E executive was chased offstage by protesters at a tech conference; that coyote on Alcatraz is probably going to have to leave; and Mayor Lurie says he is welcoming federal agents to SF for the Super Bowl.
